I wouldn’t ever really consider taking it because we didn’t get a sufficient retracement into the range, it was just a small tap and continue. I am guessing the reason for the trade was lower bias and maybe something to do with the fact there was no prior manipulation under 10:00. (Screenshot 1 & 2)

I took another breakeven trade that hit take profit right afterwards and it is a bit of a shame, but I wouldn’t change anything that I am doing, this is just how trading goes sometimes.
,
The overnight session bullish from 18:00 open, but started trading lower and by market open we had created a mmbm. the first candle of market open created. big 5min wick and we traded higher from there. I waited for 10:00 to open and we traded into that 5min gap, sweeping relative equal lows and made a 5min rb out of it which was also in the ote of the range and I entered off of it. Price traded to 10:00 so I moved my stop to breakeven, but 10:00 brought us perfectly to my stop unfortunately. I wouldn’t do this trade any differently and I would consider it a really good setup, but just unfortunate.
,
Price then rallied and I was looking for a move back to 10:00 for longs, but we never got it and kept rallying for the rest of the day. I also could have limited the 9:30 rb, but stop would be inconsistent or way too big. Overall I traded well and just have to continue doing so.
,

Session: NY am

HT Bias: During the trading session, it was kinda conflicting, I saw the NDOG and litle trading within or below midnight, however es filled it and I missed that so I should have been strictly bullish (This influenced my trading decisions). Another reason to be bullish was the respecting of 1h gap

We come down in it with 1m entry trigger and target at 10am. The reason I didn't like this was because to uncorelation between the two assets, making NQ very week, and it was trying to catch the manipulation leg, which is harder. HOWEVER, we closed strong above 10am with a 5m bearish rb with el within it. My dumbass tried to limit this targetting 10am again because we did not retrace after the strong close

Entry Confluences (minimum 3): SMT with es, bearih 5m rb, el, orderblock to the left. Limiting this was just very low probability and a more emotional loss imo trying to catch 'something'. I almost cancelled the order but price shot right into it when I tried to so I just sat it out
 
Entry Time: 10:39

SL: 5.5

RR: 6.5

Confidence: 4 (so why take it nigga bruh)

Mental State during trade: Small cortisol spike

Mental state after trade/session: This is where it gets interesting, I risked about 46 dollars, but slippage got me down 72. Now this may sound stupid, but I was lowkey pissed because I derisked a bit due to lower probability and I got still punished. I had small revenge trade thoughts but quickly faded

Result: Loss

Lesson: Don't trade against the expansion when there is clear structre above you bru
